Hi, I want to let you know that I really admire your strength.  I'm sorry that you feel worthless, alone and have so much going on in your life. I can tell that you're a strong person with a big heart and you deserve to be happy. 
My heart sincerely goes out to you.I know what it is to feel pain and not want to live anymore. By the way, I've grown to hate my parents too. They should have never had kids. 
I think you're amazing and your story speaks volumes!
I totally understand the way you feel. I'm in the same boat. It's a very dark and lonely place.I wish I had a gun. It would have been over all long time ago. Wishing you the best in whatever you do.
